origin.rerun: python3 scripts/ops/mechanics_fault_intake.py --live --since-hours 72   # compare 'N closed trade(s) read' with the journal's closed count in that window

what: mechanics_fault_intake --live under-reads: it pulls only the 300 most recent journal rows (diag journal?table=trades&limit=300, _live_trades(300)) and then filters closed_at >= now-since_hours. When more than ~300 trade rows open after a fault, that fault falls off the cap and is never filed. MEASURED 2026-11-19: the 03:44Z run (44452854714) read 29 closed trades with 12 unfiled faults; the 10:35Z run (44507023137) read 26 closed trades with 5 unfiled faults, and a 72 h dry re-run also read only 26 closed trades: the window widened but the population shrank, so up to 7 of the 12 aged out unfiled. Fix (small, Tier 1): page the diag journal (or filter server-side by closed_at) until the window is covered, and print rows_read vs window coverage so a truncated read is visible (a count that reads lower may mean we could not look).
